input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "1. Comprehensive Edge Ingress Topology and TLS Lifecycle Scope
Our distributed edge ingress infrastructure terminates HTTPS client traffic across forty-five geographic points of presence worldwide. Each edge routing cluster executes Envoy proxy processes behind Anycast BGP routing fabrics, providing resilient layer seven reverse proxying, TLS termination, and DDoS mitigation for our containerized backend services. To ensure high service availability, edge proxies load TLS certificate bundles dynamically through the Envoy Secret Discovery Service. Automatic certificate rotation sequences require close coordination between our internal certificate authority manager and edge proxy nodes. When routing decisions occur at the global edge, incoming connection packets are evaluated against regional routing matrices to direct requests to the closest healthy compute cluster.

During the quarterly certificate renewal cycle, security engineers must inspect cert underscore manager dot yaml in the deployment directory to verify automated certificate issuance pipelines. Review cdn underscore config dot json to audit default time-to-live settings and surrogate key header configurations. When backend services deploy new frontend application bundles, the deployment coordinator must trigger targeted cache invalidations rather than blanket global purges to avoid backend database connection spikes. The CDN caching layer must enforce Cache-Control headers containing public max-age and stale-while-revalidate directives. Furthermore, edge cache storage tiers must adhere to LRU memory eviction algorithms, purging stale media assets when total disk volume occupancy exceeds eighty-five percent of capacity.

4. Origin Health Probing and Upstream Failover Orchestration
Edge proxy clusters monitor origin service health using active HTTP health check probes configured with five-second polling intervals. Inspect origin underscore router dot ts to check upstream cluster failover logic and outlier detection settings. When consecutive health check failures exceed three consecutive probes, the edge proxy must gracefully drain traffic from the degraded origin node and reroute requests to secondary regional backends. Operators must never remove healthy origin targets from load balancer pools without initiating graceful connection draining. The outlier detection system must also track 5xx status code ratios across twenty-second sliding windows, isolating unstable upstream replicas before customer checkout sessions encounter fatal network exceptions.

5. Dynamic Rate Limiting and Distributed DDoS Mitigation
To protect upstream authentication and payment APIs from malicious traffic spikes, the edge gateway enforces distributed rate limiting using Redis sliding window counters. The rate limiting filter in limiter dot py tracks client IP addresses and API client keys, restricting unauthenticated requests to one hundred requests per minute. Under sudden DDoS attack conditions, security operators can activate emergency rate limiting profiles via emergency underscore config dot yaml to challenge suspicious client fingerprints with cryptographic proof-of-work challenges. Real-time customer collaboration features require persistent WebSocket connections through the edge ingress tier. Ensure that edge proxies preserve client session stickiness across WebSocket reconnections to prevent unexpected session terminations during brief wireless network handoffs. The transport buffer engine must allocate four megabytes of dedicated socket buffer memory per streaming connection to eliminate packet drops during audio keyframe transmissions.

7. High-Cardinality Telemetry and Access Log Sanitization
Every edge proxy instance emits high-cardinality OpenTelemetry traces and structured JSON access logs to our centralized telemetry ingestion pipeline. Telemetry collectors inspect request duration, upstream response latency, TLS cipher suite negotiations, and geographic point-of-presence identifiers. Review telemetry underscore logger dot ts to ensure that sensitive authorization headers and cookie tokens are redacted from access log payloads before streaming to external monitoring sinks. Log shippers must compress structured JSON events using zstandard compression to conserve cross-region transit bandwidth.

8. Emergency Rollback Playbook and Post-Incident Verification
If an automated certificate renewal deployment introduces malformed certificate chains or invalid intermediate certificates, the incident commander must execute the emergency certificate rollback sequence. The rollback script in rollback dot sh restores the previous verified certificate bundle across all edge points of presence within ninety seconds. Site reliability engineers must monitor edge HTTP 5xx error ratios on the primary Grafana dashboard to verify that customer traffic error rates return to baseline before resolving the incident.
